Subject Property Positioning

2 bed / 1 bath entire-home short-term rental. The comp set prioritizes nearby properties with similar bedroom count, bath count, and guest capacity within Hampstead.

Market Read

The Hampstead short-term rental market is small but healthy, with just 14 active listings, a market-average occupancy of 48%, and an average daily rate of $155 — meaning the subject property already prices 27% above the market average, reflecting its quality positioning. At $61 RevPAR on a trailing 12-month basis, the property currently underperforms the market's $76 RevPAR benchmark, but its recent 90-day RevPAR of $90 shows it is capable of beating the market when availability is open and demand is captured. Closing the occupancy gap to market norms is the single biggest lever available to drive revenue growth.

Performance Analytics · Market Occupancy by Month

Seasonal performance patterns

Market occupancy across the calendar year, used to time rate strategy between peak and shoulder windows.

Peak SeasonMay to Aug

Hampstead occupancy peaks during May to Aug, ranging from 59% to 68%. Premium ADR is achievable in this window; protect rate and avoid early-bird discounting that erodes peak revenue.

Shoulder SeasonSep to Apr

Occupancy softens during Sep to Apr, ranging from 39% to 53%. Strategic amenity positioning, longer-stay incentives, and gap-night pricing can lift shoulder-season occupancy meaningfully.
